signal: Wiser Solutions is navigating a sale process and serves 750+ brands and retailers, so commercial coverage matters more than ever right now

email.body1:
Dan, with Wiser serving 750+ brands and retailers, my guess is there are more in-market accounts in your patch than the team can realistically touch right now.

That is usually where good pipeline goes cold: reps spend their hours on research, writing, and CRM instead of live conversations. Our AI SDR handles all of that autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount, around 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Wiser off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing those tend to progress faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
Dan, quick follow-up for Wiser.

Most commercial teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to book to hit target, so the coverage gap shows up late and turns into a scramble. Pulling reps off accounts to fix it only makes the math worse.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Wiser needs this quarter, plus where the math breaks if you only add reps. It is built off your actual motion, not a generic template.
email.body3:
Dan, last bit of proof for Wiser.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than their team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks with every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Wiser's reply rate likely compares to similar B2B software teams. Want to hop on a quick call so I can walk you through it?
email.body4:
Dan, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling commercial pipeline without adding headcount isn't the priority this quarter, no problem at all. I know plenty competes for attention when the business is in motion.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to your retail and brand motion? I'll tailor it to Wiser either way, and you keep the thinking regardless of where it lands.
